projectionRegression.symptom: A product-created Session showed only structural native rows (model_change, thinking_level_change) while attached; reopening the page rendered the full journal.
projectionRegression.cause: The first prompt moves the native cut context. The presented LiveJournal then failed live_context_changed before applying any turn event; the Host did not retire it, so the control stream advertised no new projection and the DSH follow stream stayed in its error state.
fix: packages/sessions/supervisor.ts pollPresentation retires and republishes a presentation whose live journal fails
packages/sessions/presentation-service.ts retries a failed presentation on its next control tick
tests/sessions/source-supervisor.test.ts covers a live cut change republishing the presentation for control
